Name: CitizenM Hotels
Company description: CitizenM Hotels is a modern hospitality brand that redefines the hotel experience by offering stylish, affordable accommodations designed for the contemporary traveler. With a mission to provide a seamless and enjoyable stay, CitizenM focuses on comfort, convenience, and accessibility, allowing guests to eat and drink whenever they desire, whether it's 3:00 AM or 1:00 PM. The hotels feature a vibrant canteenM, offering a diverse breakfast buffet and a range of food and beverage options, catering to the needs of jet-lagged travelers and late-night explorers alike. Targeting tech-savvy, design-conscious individuals, CitizenM partners with local suppliers to enhance the guest experience while maintaining a commitment to sustainability. The brand's vision is to create a welcoming environment that fosters connection and relaxation, making it a preferred choice for both leisure and business travelers.

Name: FIGI
Company description: FIGI is a dynamic family-owned business located in the heart of Zeist, offering a unique blend of hospitality services, including a four-star hotel with 97 rooms, a congress center with 12 versatile meeting rooms, a cinema showcasing the latest films, and a theater hosting a diverse range of performances. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional event coordination, managing up to 1,500 guests at various events, ensuring that every detail is meticulously handled for a seamless experience. With a mission centered on hospitality and guest satisfaction, FIGI serves a wide array of clients, from corporate organizations to cultural enthusiasts, and partners with various stakeholders to deliver memorable experiences. The organization prides itself on its open communication structure and a passionate team committed to continuous personal and professional development, making it an ideal workplace for those who thrive in a vibrant and evolving environment.

Name: ANWB
Company description: ANWB is een vereniging met ruim 5 miljoen leden. Met een unieke mix van beïnvloedende en dienstverlenende activiteiten zorgen we ervoor dat ANWB-leden zorgeloos en met plezier onderweg zijn.  Activiteiten ANWB ANWB is vooral bekend van de Wegenwacht, maar we doen meer: van rijles tot actuele verkeersinformatie, van 74 ANWB-winkels tot ruim 20.000 actieve ANWB-vrijwilligers. Maar ook van de uitjes in Nederland tot aan verre reizen op maat.  Maatschappelijke organisatie ANWB is opgericht in 1883 en is vanaf het allereerste begin een  maatschappelijke organisatie. Door de omvang van de vereniging en de breedte van de werkvelden, mobiliteit, vakantie en vrije tijd, neemt ANWB in de samenleving een bijzondere positie in, bij alles wat we doen staan maatschappelijke relevantie en duurzaamheid centraal. Name: Vermaat
Company description: Vermaat is a dynamic company dedicated to enhancing the food and beverage experience for its guests while promoting responsible consumption. With a mission to make every dining experience enjoyable, Vermaat is guided by core values of being driven, entrepreneurial, skilled, inventive, and personal. The company is committed to a sustainable and inclusive future, as outlined in its Food Vision 2027, which emphasizes social responsibility and the integration of vulnerable groups into the workforce. Vermaat serves a diverse clientele, including hospitals, airports, and leisure locations, and collaborates with various partners to create opportunities for individuals facing barriers to employment. Through its initiatives, Vermaat aims to foster an inclusive corporate culture and provide fair chances for all, ensuring that everyone can participate meaningfully in society.

Name: Bink Kinderopvang
Company description: Bink Kinderopvang is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing high-quality early childhood education and care for children aged 0 to 13 years. With a focus on tailored solutions, Bink offers specialized programs for children with a VEindication, ensuring they receive the necessary support for language development and social skills through engaging activities. The company emphasizes collaboration with parents, fostering a strong bond that enhances children's trust and comfort in their learning environment. Bink operates multiple locations, including Hilversum, Soest, Soesterberg, and Huis ter Heide, and partners with local schools to provide seamless out-of-school care and transportation to various activities. Their mission is to create a nurturing and stimulating atmosphere where every child can thrive and develop through play and exploration.

Name: PPHE Hotel Group
Company description: PPHE Hotel Group is an international hospitality real estate company, with a portfolio of primarily prime freehold and long leasehold assets in Europe.   Through its subsidiaries, jointly controlled entities and associates it owns, co-owns, develops, leases, operates and franchises hospitality real estate. Its primary focus is full-service upscale, upper upscale and lifestyle hotels in major gateway cities and regional centres, as well as hotel, resort and campsite properties in select resort destinations.   PPHE Hotel Group benefits from having an exclusive and perpetual licence from the Radisson Hotel Group, one of the world's largest hotel groups, to develop and operate Park Plaza® branded hotels and resorts in Europe, the Middle East and Africa. In addition, PPHE Hotel Group wholly owns, and operates under, the art'otel® brand and its Croatian subsidiary owns, and operates under, the Arena Hotels & Apartments® and Arena Campsites® brands.   PPHE Hotel Group is one of the largest owner/operators of hotels in central London and its property portfolio comprises of 37 hotels and resorts in operation, offering a total of approximately 8,800 rooms and eight campsites, offering approximately 6,000 units. PPHE Hotel Group's development pipeline include new hotels in London, New York City, Belgrade and Zagreb which are expected to add more than 800 rooms to the portfolio.   PPHE Hotel Group is a Guernsey registered company with shares listed on the London Stock Exchange. PPHE Hotel Group also holds a controlling ownership interest in Arena Hospitality Group, whose shares are listed on the Prime market of the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

Name: Hotel Okura Amsterdam
Company description: Hotel Okura Amsterdam is THE 5* hotel in Amsterdam to work for & stay at. The most complete five-star hotel in the Netherlands, part of the Japanese chain Okura Hotels & Resorts and member of The Leading Hotels of the World. Name: Stayokay
Company description: You can find our 21 hostels in the most beautiful parts of the Netherlands. With a million overnight stays per year, Stayokay is the market leader in the Dutch group and budget accommodation sector. We place a high priority on Corporate Social Responsibility and play a leading role in the field of sustainable accommodation. Stayokay is affiliated with Hostelling International, a network of more than 4000 hostels worldwide. And building on our history facilitating youth travel, we try to keep things informal. Whether a manager, intern, working at the head office or earning extra money in housekeeping, personality is important. You can always be who you are: we are open to everyone.

Name: Bilderberg
Company description: Bilderberg is a prominent hotel chain in the Netherlands, offering a diverse range of accommodations and services tailored for both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality, Bilderberg aims to create memorable experiences through comfortable stays, extensive facilities, and personalized service. The company operates several hotels across picturesque locations, including Oosterbeek, Garderen, and Rotterdam, catering to families, couples, and corporate clients alike. Each hotel features amenities such as swimming pools, wellness centers, and meeting rooms, making them ideal for relaxation and business events. Bilderberg's commitment to sustainability is reflected in its eco-friendly practices and partnerships, ensuring a responsible approach to tourism. The target market includes domestic and international guests seeking quality accommodations, as well as businesses looking for venues for meetings and events.

Name: Sircle Collection
Company description: Sircle Collection is a dynamic hospitality and lifestyle company that operates a diverse portfolio of hotels, restaurants, and private members' clubs across major European cities, including Amsterdam, Barcelona, Berlin, and Vienna. The company is dedicated to creating unique and culturally rich experiences for its guests, with a mission to blend comfort and creativity in every aspect of its offerings. Sircle Collection's venues, such as the Max Brown hotels and The Cover members' clubs, cater to the culturally curious, providing spaces for exploration, relaxation, and social connection. The company targets a clientele that values artistic expression and community engagement, partnering with local artists and culinary talents to enhance its vibrant atmosphere. With a vision to expand its footprint in key urban markets, Sircle Collection aims to redefine the hospitality experience by merging purpose with pleasure in thoughtfully designed environments.

Name: Verwiel En Wijngaard
Company description: Verwiel & Wijngaard is a leading company in the events and hospitality sector, boasting over 30 years of experience in delivering high-end service. The company specializes in providing exceptional hospitality at prestigious events, including concerts, festivals, luxury dinners, and corporate gatherings, such as the ABN AMRO Open World Tennis Tournament and TEFAF. With a mission to achieve perfection in service and guest experience, Verwiel & Wijngaard offers flexible part-time opportunities for enthusiastic hospitality professionals, allowing them to work at exclusive venues while being part of a close-knit team. The company values proactive and service-oriented individuals, providing training and personal growth opportunities to enhance their skills. Its diverse clientele includes renowned organizations and events, making it an ideal workplace for those seeking to gain experience in a dynamic and inspiring environment.

Name: Inntel Hotels
Company description: Inntel Hotels is a prominent hotel chain in the Netherlands, known for providing exceptional hospitality and a range of services tailored to both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to create memorable experiences, Inntel Hotels focuses on comfort, convenience, and customer satisfaction, ensuring that guests feel at home during their stay. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including tourists exploring Amsterdam and business professionals seeking meeting and event spaces, with facilities that accommodate various needs. Inntel Hotels partners with local businesses to enhance guest experiences and is strategically located near key attractions, making it an ideal choice for visitors looking to immerse themselves in the vibrant culture of the city. The brand emphasizes accessibility and offers a variety of room types and amenities, ensuring that all guests, including families and those with special requirements, can enjoy a comfortable stay.

Name: Restaurant Company Europe
Company description: RCE is de restaurantgroep achter formules als Loetje, Happy Italy en Beers & Barrels. Met 65 locaties door heel Nederland behoren we tot de grootste spelers in de sector. We combineren organisatiekracht, data en technologie met de gastvrijheid van onze teams. Zo zorgen we dat elke locatie dezelfde kwaliteit biedt en gasten zich overal welkom voelen.

Name: Art'otel
Company description: art'otel is a contemporary hotel brand that combines art, design, and hospitality to create unique experiences for its guests. With a mission centered on sustainability and community engagement, art'otel aims to make a positive impact through its environmental initiatives and support for local talent. The brand features stylish accommodations and vibrant dining options, such as the ARCA Bar in Amsterdam, which offers creative cocktails and dishes inspired by Portuguese cuisine. Targeting both leisure and business travelers, art'otel partners with local artists and organizations to enhance the cultural experience of its guests. With properties across Europe, including Amsterdam, London, and Zagreb, art'otel is committed to providing memorable stays while championing sustainability and social responsibility.

Name: Hotel Co 51
Company description: Hotel Co 51 is a dynamic European hotel operator founded in Amsterdam in 2020, specializing in the development and management of Moxy Hotels, Courtyard By Marriott, Residence Inn, and AC Hotels by Marriott. With over 30 properties across eight countries, including the UK, France, and Germany, the company is committed to expanding its footprint in key European markets and airports. Hotel Co 51 aims to provide unique and engaging hospitality experiences, exemplified by its Moxy brand, which offers a playful and sociable atmosphere for travelers. The company targets international visitors and locals alike, focusing on delivering exceptional service and high-quality food and drink offerings in stylish settings. By fostering a culture of originality and nonconformity, Hotel Co 51 seeks to redefine the conventional hotel experience while ensuring guest satisfaction and operational excellence.

Name: Odyssey Hotel Group
Company description: Odyssey Hotel Group is a dynamic hospitality company that specializes in creating unique and memorable experiences for its guests through a diverse portfolio of hotels and wellness retreats. With a mission to blend comfort, style, and local culture, the group operates properties like BollAnts Spa im Park, a luxurious wellness retreat in Germany's Nahe Valley, and Moxy Darmstadt, a vibrant hotel designed for modern travelers. The company aims to provide serene environments that foster relaxation and connection, catering to both leisure and business clients. Odyssey Hotel Group partners with local suppliers to offer gourmet, regionally sourced cuisine, enhancing the overall guest experience. Targeting wellness enthusiasts, corporate clients, and travelers seeking a blend of relaxation and modern amenities, the group is committed to delivering exceptional service and personalized experiences in every location.

Name: Corendon Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Corendon Hotels & Resorts is a dynamic hospitality company that operates a diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts across the Netherlands, Curaçao, and Turkey. With a mission to provide exceptional experiences for both leisure and business travelers, Corendon emphasizes quality, comfort, and cultural engagement. The company actively supports local artists by showcasing their work in its hotels, exemplified by exhibitions like "On A Whim," which invites guests to explore contemporary art in unexpected settings. Targeting a wide range of clients, including tourists, business professionals, and local residents, Corendon aims to create vibrant meeting points that foster dialogue and connection. Through its commitment to sustainability and social responsibility, Corendon seeks to make a positive impact on the communities it serves while enhancing the overall guest experience.

Name: THE ENTOURAGE GROUP
Company description: THE ENTOURAGE GROUP - Revolutionising high-end hospitality THE ENTOURAGE GROUP is an unrivalled hospitality empire, renowned for creating internationally acclaimed food and beverage concepts across the world. Their wide range of expertise has been cultivated extensively through years of hospitality management, operations and fine dining experience.  Owners and founders Yossi Eliyahoo and Liran Wizman, along with the group’s CEO Stephanie Pearson, inspire THE ENTOURAGE GROUP to continually set the new standard for modern hospitality. The currently owned portfolio includes: MOMO Restaurant, Bar & Lounge, IZAKAYA Asian Kitchen & Bar (Amsterdam, Ibiza and Munich), MR PORTER (Amsterdam and Barcelona), awarded by Michelin THE DUCHESS, Do Not Disturb, THE BUTCHER (Amsterdam, Berlin, Ibiza and Manchester) , THE BUTCHER Social Club, THE BUTCHER On Wheels, SHIRKHAN and Toni Loco.  From Amsterdam to the capitals of Europe and beyond, THE ENTOURAGE GROUP is setting the new standard for modern, high-end hospitality.  Due to the success of the group, founder Yossi Eliyahoo was awarded ‘Hospitality Entrepreneur of the Year’ in the prestigious Entrée Hospitality Awards 2015. ‘’As a creative concept developer, I envision and feel the places I design before they actually exist. I always create places that suit the locals, but try to offer them something new at the same time. It’s extremely important to get to know the market; you can’t ignore a city and its people’s heritage. I love to develop something from the roots and pay attention to every tiny detail. Every aspect has to be captured by the same language. I’m not creating restaurants, I’m creating experiences.” – Yossi Eliyahoo, Founder & Co-Owner of THE ENTOURAGE GROUP Info@the-entouragegroup.com http://the-entouragegroup.com @the.entourage.group

Name: RAI Amsterdam
Company description: RAI Amsterdam is a premier event and exhibition center located in the heart of Amsterdam, dedicated to hosting a diverse range of international trade shows, conferences, and events. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, RAI Amsterdam aims to facilitate connections among key stakeholders in various industries, including the rapidly growing solar market, as evidenced by its collaboration with Terrapinn for the upcoming Solar & Storage Live Amsterdam in October 2025. The company’s mission is to support the energy transition and foster industry growth by providing a world-class platform for knowledge sharing and networking. RAI Amsterdam partners with local institutions and global event organizers to create impactful experiences that cater to medium to large enterprises across multiple sectors. Its strategic location and commitment to excellence make it a vital hub for industry leaders and innovators.

Name: Event Company
Company description: Event Company specializes in creating unique and memorable business gatherings in serene natural settings, primarily at Landgoed Te Werve and Te Werve Buiten. The company’s mission is to enhance productivity and well-being by leveraging the calming influence of nature, which has been shown to reduce stress, boost creativity, and improve cognitive functions. Their venues, set within a picturesque 26-hectare estate near The Hague, provide an ideal backdrop for strategic meetings, team-building activities, and client relations events. Event Company caters to a diverse clientele, including corporate teams and organizations seeking innovative solutions and effective collaboration. By combining the beauty of nature with elegant historical architecture, they aim to deliver exceptional experiences that foster personal interactions and enhance overall productivity.

Name: Cycas Hospitality
Company description: Our purpose is to develop and inspire Europe’s best hospitality team.  As an award-winning hotel management company with a distinctive people-focused culture, our proven experience of bringing brands to Europe and running great hotels that guests love, means that we’re the partner of choice for global hotel franchise brands and international investors alike. With a portfolio of 55 branded and independent properties across twelve European countries, our collection of hotels brings together a range of key-city locations, travel hubs and leisure destinations. We partner with all the major, global brands as well as curating independently branded hotels. Our hotels encompass the full spectrum, ranging from limited-service to full-service, boutique, extended-stay and luxury hotels in addition to high-end serviced apartments.

Name: Van Der Valk Exclusief
Company description: Van Der Valk Exclusief is a prominent hospitality company specializing in providing high-quality accommodations and dining experiences across its various locations. With a diverse clientele that includes both leisure and business travelers, Van Der Valk Exclusief partners with local businesses and organizations to enhance its offerings and cater to a wide range of needs. The target market encompasses families, couples, and corporate clients seeking comfortable and stylish venues for relaxation, events, and meetings. Through its commitment to excellence and innovation, Van Der Valk Exclusief aims to be a leader in the hospitality industry, ensuring that every guest feels valued and welcomed.

Name: De L'Europe Amsterdam
Company description: The story of De L’Europe Amsterdam reads like your favourite book. This monumental establishment intertwined its roots with the city’s foundation. De L’Europe is known as one of the oldest, family-owned, hotels in the heart of Amsterdam and with all famous cultural landmarks at only a stone’s throw away, it is the perfect homecoming after a full day of exploration. Next to the luxurious oasis of comfort, it is also home to a state-of-the-art wellness centre, gym, concept store In-Huys, and an extensive range of culinary experiences. The two MICHELIN-star conscious fine-dining restaurant Flore, the classic French Brasserie Marie, the authentic Italian Trattoria Graziella, speakeasy bar Chapter 1896 and the iconic Freddy’s Bar can all be found under one roof here. De L’Europe Amsterdam invites guests to discover its newest addition: ‘t Huys. A microcosm under her roof, where Amsterdam-born and bred brands take up permanent residence – bringing perennial style, sophistication, and a local ambiance.

Name: Hotel New York
Company description: Hotel New York is gevestigd in het prachtige voormalige hoofdkantoor van de Holland Amerika Lijn. Dit is de plek waar vroeger duizenden landverhuizers, vol hoop op een beter leven, vertrokken naar Noord Amerika. Tegenwoordig komen gasten hier in een bijzondere sfeer overnachten, eten, drinken, vieren en zaken doen. Meteen als je het gebouw binnen stapt, voel je het: hier is het gebeurd! De nostalgie is nog overal aanwezig: de smeedijzeren hoteltrap, de vele koffers en foto’s van landverhuizers en de voormalige kantoren van de directeuren van toen.

Name: Grand Hotel Karel V
Company description: Grand Hotel Karel V is a distinguished hotel located in a historic monument in Utrecht, known for its impressive restoration of the former Landcommanderij of the Ridderlijke Duitse Orde. The hotel is committed to sustainability, placing its guests, employees, and the quality of its offerings at the forefront of its mission. With a focus on high-quality products, Grand Hotel Karel V sources local and regional ingredients for its dining establishments, including the Brasserie Goeie Louisa and Restaurant Karel 5, while also promoting responsible consumption among its clientele. The hotel actively engages in community partnerships and cultural events, reinforcing its vision of being a socially responsible and reliable establishment. Additionally, it collaborates with the Moestuin Maarschalkerweerd to support local agriculture and provide job opportunities for individuals with barriers to employment. Through its dedication to preserving historical heritage and promoting sustainability, Grand Hotel Karel V aims to create a positive impact on both its guests and the surrounding environment.

In addition to its luxurious suites, Van der Valk Hotel Breukelen offers wellness facilities, a variety of dining options, and event spaces, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business guests. The hotel offers five-star luxury in a unique ambiance, furnished with French elegance and grandeur. The spacious, luxurious accommodations, the exceptional food and beverage proposition, the historic meeting and event venues, the indulgent Sofitel SPA and the beautiful Garden Terrace captivate and seduce everyone into visiting the hotel. Name: U.S.R. Triton
Company description: De Utrechtsche Studenten Roeivereeniging "Triton" werd op 5 oktober 1880 opgericht door leden van het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps. Triton is daarmee de oudste roeivereniging van Utrecht, vernoemd naar de Griekse halfgod Triton, half mens, half vis. Als zoon van de god van de zee, Poseidon, regeerde Triton als koning van de zee en blies hij op zijn kinkhoorn om de golven tot bedaren te brengen.  In 1972 fuseerde Triton met Opopoi, de roeivereniging van de Utrechtsche Vrouwelijke Studenten Vereeniging en werd daarmee ook toegankelijk voor vrouwelijke leden. Tegenwoordig is de U.S.R. "Triton"  een onafhankelijke vereniging waar elke student kan komen roeien. Met ruim 750 leden is een van de grootste studentenverenigingen van Utrecht. Tegenwoordig biedt de U.S.R. ruimte voor zowel breedte- als topsport. Menig student maakt hier zijn eerste halen in een roeiboot.  Recente grote successen behaalt door Tritonezen zijn de bronzen medailles op de Olympische Spelen in 2012 voor  Roline Repelaer van Driel en Anne Schellekens in de vrouwenacht en de wereldtitel voor Kaj Hendriks in de vier-zonder in 2013.  Naast het vermogen om hard te roeien heeft Triton ook een groot organisatorisch talent. Zo organiseert Triton al sinds jaar en dag de Varsity, sinds 1878 de belangrijkste studentenroeiwedstrijd van Nederland. Daarnaast organiseert Triton jaarlijks in samenwerking met de K.S.R.V. "Njord"  de Hollandia roeiwedstrijden op de Bosbaan en de Blasphemy roeiwedstrijden op het merwedekanaal.

Company description: Hell’s Kitchen Horeca Groep (HKHG) is an ambitious, professional, and bold hospitality company, consisting of 12 leading restaurants and cafés, located in the most beautiful spots in and around Rotterdam. Name: Postillion Hotels
Company description: Postillion Hotels is a prominent hotel chain in the Netherlands, offering a diverse range of accommodations and event spaces across multiple locations, including Amsterdam, Utrecht, and Deventer. The company specializes in providing comfortable lodging, flexible meeting rooms, and comprehensive event planning services, catering to both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to create memorable experiences, Postillion Hotels focuses on delivering exceptional hospitality and tailored services, ensuring that every guest's needs are met. Their target market includes corporate clients seeking venues for meetings and conferences, as well as individuals looking for romantic getaways, wellness retreats, or nature experiences. Postillion Hotels prides itself on its partnerships with local attractions and businesses, enhancing the overall guest experience while promoting the beauty and culture of the surrounding areas.

Name: De Librije
Company description: De Librije is a distinguished dining establishment and hotel that offers a unique culinary experience, serving lunch and dinner with a focus on high-quality ingredients and exceptional service. The restaurant operates from Wednesday to Saturday, welcoming guests for dinner and offering lunch on Fridays and Saturdays, while also providing accommodations for hotel guests. With a commitment to excellence, De Librije aims to create memorable dining experiences that reflect its passion for gastronomy. The establishment caters to a diverse clientele, including food enthusiasts and travelers seeking a refined culinary adventure, and is open to collaborations and partnerships within the hospitality and culinary sectors. Additionally, De Librije features a shop, Librije’s Winkel, which operates on select days, further enhancing its offerings to the community.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Den Haag - Wassenaar
Company description: Van Der Valk Hotel Den Haag - Wassenaar is a premier hospitality destination that combines modern comfort with a warm, inviting atmosphere. The hotel features Restaurant Eiber, where guests can enjoy a diverse menu of freshly prepared dishes, accommodating various dietary preferences, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. With a focus on quality and seasonal ingredients, the restaurant caters to a wide range of clientele, from families seeking a cozy dining experience to business professionals hosting meetings and events. The hotel also offers 14 well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for any occasion, from corporate gatherings to weddings, ensuring a seamless experience for all guests. Committed to providing exceptional service and a memorable stay, Van Der Valk Hotel Den Haag - Wassenaar aims to be the preferred choice for both leisure and business travelers in the region.

Name: NHL Stenden Hospitality Group
Company description: NHL Stenden Hospitality Group is the umbrella brand for Notiz Hotel, Restaurant Wannee, Meeting u and all food outlets within NHL Stenden Leeuwarden. A good cup of coffee to start the day, a tasty lunch in the restaurant or ending the day with a drink in the café. Without our guests noticing it, we flavor their day. It is about time we introduce ourselves. We are NHL Stenden Hospitality Group (NHG). Every day we make sure that the employees of our ten outlets are ready to serve you. From Notiz Hotel and Restaurant Wannee to the Espressobar and Café IF: we are your fuel for the day. We are also a pilot kitchen for our students, who gain practical experience in various departments at all our outlets. This is how we reap the benefits of NHL Stenden Hospitality Group together.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Tilburg
Company description: Van Der Valk Hotel Tilburg is a premier hospitality establishment that offers a blend of comfortable accommodations, exquisite dining, and event hosting services. The hotel is dedicated to providing guests with a memorable experience through high-quality service and a diverse culinary offering, including à la carte dining, buffets, and special events. With a mission to create a welcoming atmosphere, the hotel aims to cater to both leisure and business travelers, making it an ideal choice for families, couples, and corporate clients alike. The hotel partners with local businesses and organizations to enhance guest experiences and attract a wide range of visitors to the Tilburg area. By focusing on quality, affordability, and customer satisfaction, Van Der Valk Hotel Tilburg strives to be a leading destination for those seeking relaxation and enjoyment in a vibrant setting.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Venlo
Company description: De goede ligging in Noord-Limburg, biedt de gast een schat aan mogelijkheden, zoals sportieve activiteiten in de omliggende gebieden of een bezoek aan het nabij gelegen dorpje Arcen, waar de Kasteeltuinen en de thermaalbaden voor een aangenaam verblijf zorgen. Hotel Venlo ligt direct aan de rand van het natuurgebied Maasduinen. Ook vormt van der Valk Hotel Venlo de perfecte uitvalsbasis om heerlijk te winkelen in Düsseldorf, Oberhausen of Roermond.  Het hotel heeft een capaciteit van 149 hotelkamers en vergaderfaciliteiten tot 300 personen.  De hotelkamers zijn naast de standaard faciliteiten uitgerust met een luxe badkamer, airconditioning en internet. Er zijn ook enkele suites, een bruidssuite en voor de manager op reis een zakensuite.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Haarlem
Company description: Het Van der Valk Hotel Haarlem is gelegen aan de rand van het historische centrum van Haarlem en aan de uitvalsweg naar Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Den Haag en Utrecht. Hotel Haarlem is uitstekend te bereiken met zowel openbaar vervoer als eigen vervoer en parkeren is geen enkel probleem op de gratis parkeerplaats. Hotel Haarlem beschikt over recent gerenoveerde hotelkamers, familiekamers en suites. Tevens beschikt Hotel Haarlem over 20 multifunctionele zalen voor meetings en congressen van 2 tot 600 personen, beurzen en feestelijke bijeenkomsten. Onze hotelgasten hebben gratis toegang tot de fitness en wellness en kunnen uiteraard gratis gebruik maken van WiFi in het gehele hotel. Van der Valk Hotel Haarlem is located at the outskirts of the historic citycentre of Haarlem, near the exit routes to Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague and Utrecht. Hotel Haarlem is very easily accessible by both car, bus and public transport and we provide free parking.  Hotel Haarlem offers totally renovated hotel rooms, family rooms and suites. The hotel offers 20 muti-functional banquetrooms for meetings and congresses, from 2 to 500 persons, fairs and festive gatherings. Our hotelguests can use the facilities at the Wellness and Fitness and WiFi in the entire hotel free of charge.

Name: Foodhallen Rotterdam | Den Haag | Amsterdam
Company description: ROTTERDAM | THE HAGUE | AMSTERDAM  Founded in 2014, Foodhallen is home to a wide range of high-quality food concepts and a household name for foodlovers. Established by entrepreneurs, embraced by locals, enjoyed by visitors from all over the world. We aim to become the quality standard for local culinary culture on an international level by curating the unique food culture of a city and connect people in iconic places. We believe food is more than meets the eye. It’s a cultural thing and a sincere connector of worlds.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Leeuwarden
Company description: Van der Valk is continu in beweging en heeft eind 2017 één van haar nieuwste vestigingen aan de rand van de stad Leeuwarden geopend. Hotel Leeuwarden beschikt over 117 luxueuze kamers en suites, een congres gedeelte met moderne vergaderzalen, een à la carte restaurant, een live-cooking restaurant en een wellness/fitness.

Name: Culinair Landgoed Parc Broekhuizen
Company description: Culinair Landgoed Parc Broekhuizen is a boutique hotel and culinary destination located in a picturesque estate, offering guests a unique blend of luxury accommodation and exquisite dining experiences. The estate features characterful rooms in the Coach House and the Main House, designed to provide a serene atmosphere with modern amenities, including complimentary minibars and Zenology cosmetics. The mission of Parc Broekhuizen is to create memorable experiences through exceptional hospitality, gourmet dining at the Michelin-starred Restaurant Voltaire, and the inviting Bistro LOF, which emphasizes fresh, local ingredients. The target market includes leisure travelers, food enthusiasts, and those seeking a tranquil retreat for group gatherings or special events. With a commitment to quality and comfort, Parc Broekhuizen aims to be a premier destination for both relaxation and culinary exploration.

Name: Winkel Van Sinkel
Company description: De Winkel van Sinkel bevindt zich in hartje Utrecht aan de sfeervolle Oudegracht. Het monumentale, neo-classicistische pand huisvest een unieke combinatie van horeca en cultuur. Niet alleen is er een stijlvol grandcafé-restaurant, er zijn ook twee terrassen, een binnentuin, expositieruimtes, een cocktail-lounge, een prachtige Serre en in de kelder een 2e restaurant: De Tapas Kelder.  De Winkel is nauw betrokken bij de vele festivals die de stad kent en neemt uitgebreid deel aan Utrechts Culturele Zondagen. Elke zaterdagnacht wordt het pand omgetoverd tot de trendy club NACHTWINKEL waar tot diep in de nacht gedanst wordt. De Winkel van Sinkel heeft een moderne maar toch klassieke uitstraling. Onze keuken is mondiaal: van Frans tot oosters. Alle gerechten worden à la minute bereid.

Name: Blooming
Company description: Blooming is a unique meeting and event venue nestled in the heart of the North Holland Dune Reserve, offering a serene and inspiring environment for gatherings of all kinds. The company specializes in providing tailored meeting arrangements, featuring 14 versatile meeting rooms, each with stunning views of the surrounding forest, and direct access to nature. Blooming's mission is to foster creativity and collaboration by creating a tranquil atmosphere where the best ideas can flourish. Their clients range from corporate teams to educational groups, all seeking a refreshing alternative to traditional meeting spaces. With amenities such as interactive presentation screens, organic refreshments, and opportunities for outdoor activities, Blooming aims to enhance the meeting experience and promote a sense of well-being among participants. The venue also offers comfortable accommodations, making it an ideal choice for extended events or retreats.

Name: Idora Horeca Service
Company description: Idora Horeca Service is a dynamic hospitality service agency based in Rotterdam, specializing in providing skilled personnel for various events and establishments within the horeca sector. Founded by twin brothers Kaveh and Arash Idora, the company is driven by a mission to deliver "quality service with a smile," ensuring that guests receive exceptional hospitality through well-trained staff who embody a genuine sense of warmth and professionalism. Idora Horeca Service partners with a diverse range of clients, including restaurants, hotels, and event organizers, and is committed to fostering strong relationships with both clients and employees. The company also emphasizes the importance of training and development through its Idora Academy, preparing its workforce to excel in the fast-paced hospitality environment. With a focus on customer satisfaction and operational excellence, Idora Horeca Service aims to support its clients in achieving successful business outcomes while promoting a positive and collaborative work culture.

Name: Hands On Events
Company description: Hands on Events is van start gegaan als schakel tussen werkgevers en werknemers voor horeca ondersteuning tijdens events. Hands on Events is in een paar jaar uitgegroeid tot een professionele partner op het gebied van personeelsinzet voor:     Horeca     Barmedewerkers, bedieningmedewerkers en koks     Events     Garderobemedewerkers, alcoholcontroleurs en heftruckchauffeurs     Hospitality     VIP-hostesses en ticketscan medewerkers     Promotion     Promotiemedewerkers     Sales      Kassamedewerkers en mobiele (bier)teams Hands on Events is te vinden op diverse grote en kleine evenementen en festivals. Op beurzen en evenementen kunt u met een glimlach ontvangen worden door de Hands on Events gastvrouwen of kunt u de promotiemedewerkers tegenkomen die u kennis laten maken met nieuwe producten. Hands on Events staat in de branche bekend om de inzet van de mobiele (bier)teams. U kent wellicht de biertassen wel waarmee het team geen enkele locatie tijdens een evenement vergeet te voorzien van een mooi getapt biertje. Ook in horeca gelegenheden zetten we koks en medewerkers bediening in bij tijdelijk personeelstekort of ziekte van het vaste personeel. Ben je op zoek naar een toffe baan waar je jouw kwaliteiten kunt inzetten? Hands on Events verbindt onze opdrachtgevers en onze medewerkers graag met elkaar! Kwaliteit staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Voor onze werknemers zorgen we voor goede werkomstandigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling waarbij ook plezier in het werk niet vergeten wordt! "Your success in our hands"

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Tiel
Company description: Van Der Valk Hotel Tiel is a premier hospitality destination located conveniently along the A15, offering a blend of comfort and sustainability. The hotel features over 180 well-appointed rooms and 18 multifunctional event spaces, accommodating gatherings from intimate meetings to large conferences of up to 2,000 guests. Committed to environmental stewardship, the hotel operates the Green Stays initiative, allowing guests to contribute to reforestation efforts by opting out of interim room cleaning, with a tree planted for each choice made. This initiative aligns with the hotel's mission to promote sustainable practices while providing exceptional service to both corporate and private clients. With a focus on creating memorable experiences, Van Der Valk Hotel Tiel caters to a diverse clientele, including business professionals, event organizers, and families celebrating special occasions. The hotel also offers a variety of dining options, ensuring that every guest's culinary preferences are met.

Name: Kinderopvang Op Stoom
Company description: Kinderopvang Op Stoom is a distinctive childcare organization that prioritizes the learning process of children over the end products they create. With a mission to provide adventurous and engaging care, Op Stoom focuses on nurturing toddlers and school-age children, helping them develop into happy and independent individuals. The company operates various childcare services, including daycare, after-school care, and toddler care, catering to families seeking quality early childhood education. Op Stoom is committed to making bold pedagogical choices and fostering a supportive environment where children can explore their limits and learn through play. The organization collaborates with parents and educational partners to ensure a holistic approach to child development, making it a trusted choice for families in the community.

Name: Dorhout Mees - Congres & Teambuilding
Company description: Dorhout Mees - Congres & Teambuilding is a premier event location specializing in hosting conferences and team-building activities. The company is dedicated to creating memorable experiences that foster collaboration and innovation among teams. With a focus on optimizing functionality and effectiveness, Dorhout Mees aims to provide a seamless and engaging environment for its clients. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including corporate organizations and teams looking to enhance their teamwork and communication skills. By partnering with various stakeholders, Dorhout Mees strives to deliver exceptional service and create impactful events that align with the goals of its clients.

Name: Rotterdam Ahoy
Company description: Rotterdam Ahoy is a premier event and entertainment venue located in Rotterdam, Netherlands, known for hosting a diverse range of events including concerts, sports competitions, and cultural festivals. The venue aims to create memorable experiences for its visitors by providing a platform for both international and local artists, as well as engaging events that cater to a wide audience. With a mission to connect people through entertainment, Rotterdam Ahoy collaborates with notable partners such as the NN North Sea Jazz Festival and the ABN AMRO Open, attracting a variety of clients from the entertainment and sports industries. Its target market includes music lovers, sports fans, and families seeking unique live experiences, making it a vibrant hub for cultural exchange and entertainment in the region.

Name: Models At Work
Company description: Models at Work is committed to match the right looks and great working spirit of our models to events, promotional activities or parties. Models at Work has departments for working models for hosting, food and beverages, promotional activities, television, receptionists, fitting models and acts/performances. Not only will they be able to represent your brand/company by their appearance, we will also select our models on character and experience. It is very important for both you and us that models match the specific look and feel of your brand or product, even more important: a host(ess) should be able to transfer the right feeling in relation to your company, to your clients.

Name: Volkshotel
Company description: Wij zijn open voor iedereen, die open staat voor iedereen. Volkshotel bestaat dankzij alle mensen die er kwamen, zijn, en nog gaan komen. De makers van de krant, vroeger. De creatieven en de krakers die er zaten. Haar gasten, haar locals, en misschien wel dankzij jou. Het Amsterdamse Volkshotel is een plek voor alleenstaande moeders, dandy’s, kunstenaars, onderwaterlassers en nachtvlinders. In Volkshotel komen Amsterdammers en reizigers samen om te eten, drinken, werken en feesten. Laagdrempelig en voor een eerlijke prijs. Kunst en cultuur zijn verweven in de geschiedenis van het pand en blijven ook in de toekomst een grote rol spelen. Met een café, nachtelijke cocktailbar, club, restaurant, broedplaats, badplaats, flexwerkplekken en 216 hotelkamers is het Volkshotel een plek waar 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week iets gebeurt. Eenmaal binnen, hoef je eigenlijk nooit meer naar huis.

Name: De Drie Gezusters - Grand Café & Terras
Company description: Groningen en De Drie Gezusters zijn onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. Gelegen in het Stadshart van Groningen kun je wel stellen dat De Drie Gezusters sinds de jaren 70 hét Grand Café van Groningen is.  Het verhaal gaat dat de drie dochters van Peter Stuyvesant, voormalig bestuurder van New York, niet konden aarden in de Victoriaanse tijd door de strenge fatsoensnormen en het conservatisme. Op een goed moment namen de drie dochters hun intrede in het statige steenhuis op deze plek, dat reeds dateert uit het jaar 1225. Aan de voet van d’Olle Grieze maakten zij destijds al kennis met de echte Groningse gastvrijheid. Sindsdien is er veel gezelligheid te bekennen in ons karakteristieke pand aan de Grote Markt en dat is door de jaren heen nooit veranderd. Met respect voor onze rijke historie eren wij de drie zusjes vandaag de dag nog steeds en draagt ons Grand Café vol trots de naam De Drie Gezusters. Zowel binnen in ons sfeervol ingerichte Grand Café als buiten op ons verwarmde terras is het mogelijk om gezellig en intiem te genieten van kofﬁe- en theespecialiteiten, lunch, diner en een lekkere borrel!

Name: Droomparken
Company description: Droomparken heet nu ook EuroParcs. EuroParcs Group is een oer-Nederlands familiebedrijf. Wij hebben inmiddels meer dan 60 vakantieparken op de allermooiste locaties, midden in de natuur, in het bos, in de bergen, aan het water, dicht bij culturele steden. Onze core business is de ontwikkeling van vakantieparken, de verkoop van vakantiewoningen aan particulieren en zakelijke beleggers en de verhuur ervan aan particuliere en zakelijke gasten. We zien het als onze taak dat de aankoop van onze vakantiewoningen door particulieren en beleggers en het verhuur aan particuliere en zakelijke gasten een unieke verrassende en plezierige ervaring betekent in alle facetten.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Maastricht
Company description: Van der Valk Hotel Maastricht is opgericht in 1999 en op 27 december van dat jaar werd de eerste kamer in gebruik genomen. Inmiddels zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een begrip in Maastricht met 190 ruime hotelkamers en luxe suites, 11 multifunctionele vergaderruimtes, een brasserie en een a la carte restaurant. Multifunctionele vergaderzalen Onze 11 multifunctionele zalen zijn stuk voor stuk sfeervol ingericht en beschikken allemaal over natuurlijk daglicht. Door de diversiteit aan zaalcapaciteiten (tot 350 personen in één zaal) is er voor iedere vergadering of congres een geschikte ruimte aanwezig. Comfortabele stoelen, airconditioning en moderne technische faciliteiten zorgen ervoor dat u het maximale uit uw vergadering kunt halen. Comfortabele kamers De 190 ruime hotelkamers, 102 Comfort kamers, 77 Comfort Deluxe kamers en 11 Suites bieden volop comfort voor luxueus ontspannen na een dagje uit.  Restaurant Geniet als een echte Bourgondiër bij Hotel van der Valk Maastricht. Wij verzorgen voor u een uitgebreid ontbijtbuffet, een luxe lunch of een culinair diner. Brasserie St. Pieter U kunt er terecht voor een heerlijke cappuccino en een knapperige salade of een heerlijke saté. Maar liefst 6 verschillende ambachtelijke bieren van het vat wachten om door u geproefd te worden. Het is deze ongedwongen, vriendelijke sfeer die veel hotelgasten vlak voordat de nacht invalt, hier nog even doet ontspannen. Ligging Hotel van der Valk Maastricht is direct gelegen aan de snelweg A2, aan de rand van het stadscentrum, op loopafstand van het MECC en slechts 20 minuten van Maastricht Airport. Nijverheidsweg 35 6227 AL Maastricht Nederland Telefoon: +31 (0) 43 387 35 00 Email: maastricht@valk.nl Website: www.hotelvandervalkmaastricht.nl

Name: Café Restaurant De Eendracht
Company description: Café Restaurant De Eendracht is a cherished gathering place in Abcoude, known for its warm atmosphere and exceptional cuisine. With a mission to create a welcoming environment reminiscent of home, the restaurant invites locals, friends, family, and colleagues to enjoy good company and delicious meals. The menu features a selection of high-quality dishes, sourced from local suppliers and tailored to seasonal availability, ensuring there is something for everyone, whether they prefer meat, fish, or vegetarian options. Established in 1734 as a local inn with a rich history, De Eendracht has evolved over the years, serving as a hotel, coffee house, and community meeting spot. After a significant renovation in 2012, the restaurant was restored to its former glory, becoming a vibrant hub for the community. Celebrating over 290 years of tradition, Café Restaurant De Eendracht continues to be a beloved destination for both locals and visitors seeking a memorable dining experience.

Name: Bar & Restaurant Milú
HQ Location: Netherlands, South Holland, The Hague, 15 Driehoekjes, 2513
Company description: Bij Bar & Restaurant Milú draait alles om proeven en genieten. With a wide selection of beers and wines, surprising cocktails and an international kitchen, Bar & Restaurant Milú guarantees a wonderful evening!

Name: Park Centraal Hotels
Company description: As the name suggests, Park Centraal focuses on central locations in Amsterdam and The Hague imbued with contemporary design, heritage and locally-inspired spaces that breathe Dutch culture throughout. With an ethos inspired by the high quality of life in The Netherlands, Park Centraal reflects the country’s balanced and social lifestyle, where a healthy work life is enjoyably combined with the pleasure of enjoying vibrant bars, music and food.  www.parkcentraalhotels.com @parkcentraalhotels

Name: Foodhall MOUT
Company description: Combineert het stoere van een Foodhall met service.

Name: The College Hotel Amsterdam Autograph Collection
Company description: The College Hotel Amsterdam, part of the Autograph Collection, is a distinctive boutique hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam's Oud-Zuid district. Housed in a historic building that once served as a school, the hotel combines rich heritage with modern luxury, offering 40 unique rooms that reflect its storied past. The hotel's mission is to provide guests with a memorable experience that blends nostalgia and contemporary comfort, while its vision focuses on creating lasting memories through exceptional service and hospitality. Catering to both leisure and business travelers, The College Hotel Amsterdam also features versatile meeting spaces and event facilities, making it an ideal choice for weddings, corporate gatherings, and social events. With its proximity to major attractions like the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, the hotel attracts a diverse clientele seeking an authentic Amsterdam experience.

Name: The Good Hotel
Company description: The Good Hotel is no ordinary hotel. Here we say: “Sleep Good Do Good”. Sleep Good - expect comfy beds, calming views, sleek design, and a great hospitality experience. Company description: Mercure Hotel Tilburg Centrum is the perfect place to enjoy your trip. There is more than enough to enjoy in the accommodation itself which provides a home away from home. For example, why not dine at our bar which is passionate about food and drink. We particularly enjoy welcoming business guests who can choose from one of our fully catered meeting packages.

Name: Van Der Valk Hotel Breda
Company description: Van Der Valk Hotel Breda is a premier hospitality destination located in the picturesque Noord-Brabant region, offering a versatile venue for various events, including business meetings, weddings, and celebrations. The hotel prides itself on its modern facilities, professional support, and exceptional catering services, ensuring that every occasion is memorable. With a central location near the A16, it is easily accessible for both local and international guests. The hotel features a range of well-equipped meeting rooms and comfortable accommodations, making it an ideal choice for corporate clients, event planners, and families alike. Committed to quality, comfort, and hospitality, Van Der Valk Hotel Breda aims to create unforgettable experiences for all its visitors.

Name: Restaurant Party- En Congresscentrum Boerke Mutsaers
Company description: Restaurant Party - En Congresscentrum Boerke Mutsaers is a premier dining and event venue that excels in providing exceptional culinary experiences and hosting a wide range of events, from corporate meetings to private celebrations. The establishment's mission is to create memorable moments through exquisite food and personalized service, ensuring that every guest feels valued and catered to. With a vision to be the leading destination for both dining and event hosting in the region, Boerke Mutsaers fosters a welcoming atmosphere that encourages community engagement and connection. The venue caters to a diverse clientele, including local businesses, families, and organizations, making it an ideal choice for celebrations, meetings, and special occasions. Boerke Mutsaers emphasizes quality and sustainability by partnering with local suppliers, ensuring that every dish reflects the region's rich culinary heritage. This commitment to fresh, high-quality ingredients is a cornerstone of the restaurant's offerings. Targeting both corporate clients and private individuals, Boerke Mutsaers is dedicated to tailoring each event to perfection, providing versatile event spaces and high-quality catering. The venue's focus on customer satisfaction and attention to detail sets it apart as a premier choice for memorable gatherings. Whether hosting a wedding, a business meeting, or a festive gathering, Boerke Mutsaers is committed to delivering outstanding service and a delightful culinary journey, making it the go-to destination for significant events in the community.

Name: Hotel Van Der Valk Eindhoven
Company description: Hotel Van Der Valk Eindhoven is a premier hotel that serves as an ideal base for sports teams seeking comfortable and comprehensive training camps or stays. The hotel is dedicated to providing athletes with the necessary facilities to perform at their best while also ensuring they have opportunities to relax. With excellent hotel amenities and direct access to high-quality sports facilities in the vicinity, guests benefit from short travel times and professional training environments. The hotel offers tailored services such as sports meals, catering, accommodation, meeting rooms for team discussions, and fitness facilities. Its strategic location near various sports complexes, including FC Eindhoven, PSV Stadion, and Genneper Sportparken, makes it a favored choice for teams preparing for tournaments or training sessions. Hotel Van Der Valk Eindhoven aims to support athletes in their pursuit of excellence while providing a welcoming and supportive atmosphere.
